description:
Cast Crookshank Kobolds by paying {0}.
Crookshank Kobolds enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio and Blessed Sanctuary.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning nothing from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Blessed Sanctuary, creating a 2/2 Unicron creature token.
The Unicorn enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio, returning Crookshank Kobolds from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
